Drop-off at the front entrance. Shop at The Hyundai Seoul, then enjoy the night view at Yeouido Hangang Park.
faq: Is Japanese spoken?
Yes. From booking through contact on the day, we support you in Japanese via LINE. Drivers on the day also speak simple Japanese.
What happens if my flight is delayed?
We track your flight's arrival time while we wait. There is no extra charge for delays.
How can I pay?
You can pay on the day in cash (won or yen) or by credit card.
Is there a cancellation fee?
Cancellation is free up to the day before. Same-day cancellation costs 50% of the price.
